key_reasoning.reason: New legacy-metrics-gate abstraction (freeze-at-start + send-time verdict with final vs transient outcomes) wired into four subsystems: the CLI hook (SessionStart consent freeze, start metric), hook end-metric and delivery accounting, session core (SessionStore merge, Session type, stale-session reconciliation), and the SSO metrics-sync processor; it also reads evidence stop-marker, record-store and the otlp-spool session status. Base L, bumped to XL because the gate governs several independent sender workflows (start, end, usage deltas, stale re-delivery).

Consent/compliance gating that has to fail closed. The closest pattern is the new pipeline's consent-store/stop-marker/spool-status checks, which are reused here. Still, the final-skip vs transient-retry semantics (endMetricSkipped persisted as delivered vs nothing persisted) and the session-id path-safety check are new. Base M, bumped to L for the compliance/consent requirement.

14 files changed per diffstat (718 insertions): 1 new source module (legacy-metrics-gate.ts), 2 new test files (legacy-metrics-gate.test.ts, hook.legacy-metrics-gate.test.ts), the rest modified, across src/agents/core/session, src/agents/core/evidence, src/cli/commands(/hook) and src/providers/plugins/sso/session/processors/metrics. Falls in the 11-15 band, so XL.

4 layers: CLI/API (hook command handlers), Service (gate verdict logic, metrics-sync processor), DB-Persistence (new persisted legacyMetricsConsent field on the Session record plus SessionStore merge; reads stop-marker and spool status files), and External (gating outbound POST /v1/metrics). The persisted session schema gains an additive field with no migration, so L. Total 21 sits right on the M/L boundary; with Component Scope at XL it leans L, matching the project L calibration example profile-provider-decoupling (23).
